notes: Rousing Read (M21): 'Enchant creature. When this Aura enters, draw two cards, then discard a card. Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has flying.' Cast on seat 0's Bear; the ETB draws two and the controller chooses to discard Junk (not the lowest-handle card, Keeper). Then Thrashing Brontodon destroys the Aura: the Bear is a 2/2 without flying again. Hand: Keeper + Junk, cast -> 2, draw 2 -> 4, discard Junk -> 3.
